semantics.submit_residual: Submit minus the union of exclusive children; exactly equals submit_internal_residual plus submit_tail_residual
semantics.submit_internal_residual: unattributed prefix and child-to-child gaps inside Submit
semantics.submit_tail_residual: unattributed suffix from the final exclusive child end to Submit end; not a standalone business phase
semantics.between_submit_residual: unattributed gap from one Submit end to the next Submit begin

global_submit_makespan.semantics: cross-core wall-clock envelope; not aggregate core-work

aggregate_core_work.semantics: sum of per-core cycles; not wall-clock duration

semantics.materialize_before_publish_task_outputs: Materialize.start to output-publication.start; task materialization plus writer-delta preparation
semantics.materialize_publish_task_outputs_copy: SharedMaterializePublishTaskOutputsCopy; batch TensorDesc copy into shared_outputs[task].tensors[]
semantics.materialize_publish_task_outputs_residua: output envelope minus copy/flush: pre-check, last_writer FetchMax, StoreBarrier, published Exchange, and helper overhead
semantics.materialize_after_publish_task_outputs: output-publication.end to Materialize.end; phase closure and outer timestamp
semantics.raw_arithmetic: integer cycle boundaries; merged swimlane is not read

semantics.register_wait_predecessor_insert: Register.start to SharedRegisterPublishMetadata.start; task 0 enters directly, while task N waits for task N-1 to publish its TensorMap insertion completion
semantics.register_publish_writer_metadata: the serialized ordinary/symbol writer publication. In new captures this is the complete SharedRegisterPublishMetadata span; legacy captures end at task-output publication start
semantics.register_publish_task_outputs: legacy compatibility field; exactly zero when output_placement is materialize
semantics.register_publish_task_outputs_copy: SharedRegisterPublishTaskOutputsCopy; batch TensorDesc copy into shared_outputs[task].tensors[]
semantics.register_publish_task_outputs_flush: SharedRegisterPublishTaskOutputsFlush; FlushRegion of the copied descriptors before StoreBarrier/published
semantics.register_publish_task_outputs_residual: task-outputs envelope minus copy/flush: pre-check, last_writer FetchMax, StoreBarrier, and published Exchange
semantics.register_publish_metadata_epilogue: legacy compatibility field after Register-owned output publication; exactly zero in new captures
semantics.register_publish_insert_completion: SharedRegisterPublishMetadata.end to Register.end; publish this task's TensorMap insertion completion for its successor
semantics.raw_arithmetic: integer cycle boundaries; merged swimlane is not read

residual_breakdown.semantics: aggregate positive gaps between existing exclusive boundaries; tail remains residual and is not a standalone business phase

semantics.fixed_counts: observed winner/loser classifications plus the exact core_count × task_count total; these counts are comparison populations, not a new one-winner-per-task protocol oracle
semantics.actor_window: Submit_i.start through Submit_{i+1}.start; the final task ends at OrchestrationReplay.end
semantics.control: gross minus the interval union of Kernel events inside this Submit's EfDrain
semantics.post_claim_tail: remaining Submit control after removing EfDrain and Claim; it includes all later frontend/tail work and any unattributed Submit gaps
semantics.post_transition: current Submit.end through the next Submit.start, or through OrchestrationReplay.end for the final task
semantics.distribution: sum/mean/median and nearest-rank p95 over fixed actor instances
